name: POC Studio Live app: Feedback page skill loop
summary: The Feedback page shows each skill's current version, its approved version history and a pending prompt suggestion that only a manager can approve.
body:
## What it does
On `/feedback` of the POC Studio Live code app (app-79ea7266eab9, published v2), each skill group's summary card shows:
- the current version (`v{n} · approved {date}`) and a **Suggestion pending** tag when a `psl_skill_suggestion` row is pending;
- a version list from the skill's approved suggestions, newest first, three shown and the rest behind a chevron;
- the pending suggestion as the first item of the group's stack: an AI Insight card with the current prompt beside the proposed one (no diff), the evidence tickets linking to the articles below, and one **Approve v{n}** button.

## Rules
- Approve is shown only when the viewer's email or full name equals `manager_email` or `manager_name` on any `psl_poc` row (case-insensitive). Everyone else sees "A manager approves this."
- A group with a pending suggestion stays visible whatever the status filter.
- Approve calls **POC Studio Live · Approve skill suggestion** with `suggestion_id`, `caller_email`, `caller_name`, reads the result's `status` (approved, already_decided, forbidden, not_found, error) and shows a toast for each; the skill, suggestion and feedback lists reload after.

## Data
Reads `psl_skill`, `psl_skill_suggestion`, `psl_feedback`, `psl_poc`; the Approve call goes through automation data source e_6ad1cf9fc0f97b3e983d929d.

## Not taken from the source app
The source app app-b4fe5a0a30eb later moved this to a separate Skills & Feedback page at /skills with other objects and automations; that layout was not ported because it conflicts with this app's design (no new rail item, no diff view).
